about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Sheri Biggs

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPROVING TRAVEL FOR MILITARY MEMBERS ACT
statements.title: IMPROVING TRAVEL FOR MILITARY MEMBERS ACT
sentences: I urge my colleagues to support this important piece of legislation for our servicemembers and their families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOURTH ANNIVERSARY OF DOBBS DECISION
statements.title: FOURTH ANNIVERSARY OF DOBBS DECISION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, 4 years ago, the Supreme Court made the right decision in Dobbs and returned the issue of abortion to the American people and their elected representatives.
For nearly 50 years, Roe v. Wade prevented States from protecting unborn children and advancing policies that reflected the values of their citizens.

Today, abortion pills account for the majority of abortions in America, and women are increasingly being prescribed these drugs without an in-person medical examination and with little accountability.
That is why I am introducing legislation to strengthen safeguards surrounding the dispensing of abortion drugs and to ensure that women receive the care and protections they deserve.
As we mark this anniversary, I remain committed to defending the unborn, to supporting mothers, and building a culture that values every human life.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE AMERICA ACT
statements.title: SECURE AMERICA ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the Secure America Act gives Border Patrol and ICE the resources they need to keep doing what is working.
Southwest border apprehensions are down 94 percent compared to the Biden administration.
This bill invests in agents, officers, technology, and the tools needed to dismantle cartels, stop human trafficking, and remove criminal illegal aliens from our communities.
President Trump has proven that a secure border is possible.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the Secure America Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL POLICE WEEK
statements.title: NATIONAL POLICE WEEK
sentences: Mr. Speaker, during National Police Week, we honor the brave men and women in law enforcement who put on the badge each day, knowing the risks that come with serving others.
Today, I rise to remember Greenwood Police Officer Don ``DJ'' Keller who passed away earlier this week while faithfully serving his community.
He represented the very best of law enforcement.
May God bless Officer Keller, his family, and every law enforcement officer serving our communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SHARIA-FREE AMERICA
statements.title: SHARIA-FREE AMERICA
sentences: We are not going to apologize for defending our country, our Constitution, or our way of life.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7744, FURTHER ADDITIONAL CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7744, FURTHER ADDITIONAL CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, America has dealt a clear and decisive blow to the Iranian terrorist regime.
DHS supports the law enforcement officers who keep our communities safe.

As a psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner, I have seen these warriors return home with tremendous weight and trauma on their minds and in their hearts and the weight of the world on their shoulders.
For nearly 50 years, the Iranian regime fueled terrorism.
President Trump made it clear that Iran would never obtain a nuclear weapon.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF S. 1383, VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2189, LAW- ENFORCEMENT INNOVATE T
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF S. 1383, VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2189, LAW- ENFORCEMENT INNOVATE TO DE-ESCALATE ACT; PROVIDING FOR...
sentences: We have seen the chaos at the border.
The SAVE America Act helps prevent that.
This bill delivers on one of President Trump's top priorities, and that is to secure our elections and to make sure only citizens vote.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of the rule.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
statements.title: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
sentences: Not only do I have my doctorate in family practice but also in psychiatric mental health.
As thousands gather in Washington for the March for Life, we are reminded that the pro-life cause isn't just about protecting the unborn, but it is about honoring life at every single stage.
That is why I rise today in support of H.R. 6945, the Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act.

This bill reflects what we believe: that every single life is a gift from God, every mother deserves compassion, and every child deserves a chance because, as Scripture reminds us: ``I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.'' Mr. Speaker, I am proud to support this important legislation, and I urge my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ICE UNDER ATTACK
statements.title: ICE UNDER ATTACK
sentences: As a psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner, I have met with families in the hardest moments of their lives, and I have seen what happens when the system fails to connect with someone in a crisis to get the help that they may need.
Mr. Speaker, in the coming days, I will be introducing legislation to ensure our guardsmen are better protected and supported, both during deployments like this and beyond.
That is why I have introduced the Hope Heals Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to join me in this mission.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
statements.title: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
sentences: Peace is maintained through strength, and it would be both unconstitutional and irresponsible to tie the hands of the President, who is protecting the American people from drug cartels and terrorist tactics.
The President's targeted strikes on narcoterrorist vessels have been precise and targeted and have not put U.S. troops in harm's way.
Mr. Speaker, the War Powers Resolution was never intended to be a tool for the legislative branch to conduct tactical oversight of military operations.

Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to the resolution which seeks to limit the constitutional authority of the President under Article II and micromanage the Commander in Chief during a national security crisis.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3898, PROMOTING EFFICIENT REVIEW FOR MODERN INFRASTRUCTURE TODAY ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3383, INCREASING INVES
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3898, PROMOTING EFFICIENT REVIEW FOR MODERN INFRASTRUCTURE TODAY ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3383, INCREASING INVESTOR OPPORTUNITIES ACT; PROVIDING...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of the rule and the fiscal year '26 National Defense Authorization Act.

As both a Member of Congress and a lieutenant colonel in the Air National Guard, I understand what it takes to keep our Nation secure, and I am proud to support key priorities in this bill that deliver on that mission.
Mr. Speaker, I urge support for the bill and the underlying bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ADDRESSING SOUTH CAROLINA'S MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS
statements.title: ADDRESSING SOUTH CAROLINA'S MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS
sentences: Having counseled hundreds of patients and as a psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner, I have seen what suffering looks like when it hides behind a smile.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MADE-IN-AMERICA DEFENSE ACT
statements.title: MADE-IN-AMERICA DEFENSE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, President Trump made it clear: Put American jobs first, and cut the Washington red tape.
The Made-in-America Defense Act strengthens domestic manufacturing.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING OUR ARMED FORCES
statements.title: SUPPORTING OUR ARMED FORCES
sentences: That is why, this week, I introduced my first bill in Congress, the FIGHTER Act, to provide long-overdue tax relief to America's Active- Duty servicemembers.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to stand with our warfighters, to support the FIGHTER Act, and to give our heroes the relief they have earned. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICA FIRST POLICIES
statements.title: AMERICA FIRST POLICIES
sentences: President Trump is now at the helm, and I am confident that with his administration, in partnership with this House and our Senate colleagues, we will turn the page with policies that put America First, win the border war, protect tax dollars, keep our promises that were made to our veterans, and defend our sacred values.
